data.name: Drawn™: Trail of Shadows Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
e-enter the enchanted world of Drawn in the highly anticipated third installment of the cinematic series. Nominated for the 2012 AIAS Downloadable Game of the Year!

Set in the years before the events of The Painted Tower and Dark Flight, Drawn: Trail of Shadows takes players on a magical journey through the distant past. Become a part of the story by following clues scattered throughout paintings to save a boy with the power to create painted worlds. Discover and confront the source of evil that seeks to possess that power...


See the world of Drawn as never before while traveling deep into each painting. Explore a fantastic garden; climb high into frozen mountain passes, and unlock the mysteries of the Ferryman’s caves on your quest to save the boy that creates the painted worlds. Who is he? What role will he play in the future of the kingdom?


The answers to these questions will be found along the trail of shadows.


  • Enter dozens of paintings
  • Interact with an evolving pop-up book
  • Discover the hidden past of Drawn!


This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version. The Collector’s Edition includes:

  • Bonus gameplay
  • Stunning screensavers
  • Incredible artwork

reviews.review:
Drawn: Trail of Shadows Collector's Edition is a fantasy point-and-click adventure developed by Big Fish Studios and published by BFG Entertainment. Serving as a prequel to the earlier games in the Drawn series, it tells the origins of the magical world through a heartfelt narrative centered on imagination, destiny, and the extraordinary power of art. Rather than relying on fast-paced action or combat, the game invites players to immerse themselves in a beautifully illustrated kingdom where every painting holds secrets and every location contributes to an enchanting fairy tale. The result is an experience that prioritizes atmosphere and storytelling while remaining approachable for both longtime adventure fans and newcomers.

One of the game's defining qualities is its remarkable visual design. Every environment resembles a hand-painted illustration brought to life, featuring vibrant landscapes, intricate castles, mysterious forests, and magical structures that constantly encourage exploration. The developers clearly focused on creating a world that feels alive through artistic detail instead of technical spectacle. The Collector's Edition further expands the experience with an exclusive bonus chapter, collectible items, concept artwork, wallpapers, music, and achievements, offering additional incentives for players who enjoy uncovering every secret and appreciating the creative work behind the game.

The story unfolds through a captivating fantasy narrative that gradually reveals the history behind the kingdom and its remarkable inhabitants. As players journey through enchanted locations, they encounter memorable characters whose lives are connected by ancient magic and artistic creation. The narrative steadily introduces mysteries surrounding gifted individuals, forgotten legends, and the forces threatening this imaginative world. While the overall plot follows a linear progression, its pacing remains engaging because each new chapter introduces fresh discoveries that naturally encourage players to continue exploring.

Puzzle design is where Drawn: Trail of Shadows truly distinguishes itself from many traditional hidden object adventures. Instead of constantly searching for scattered objects, players spend much of their time solving creative environmental puzzles, manipulating magical devices, restoring artwork, and interacting with imaginative mechanisms that feel integrated into the story rather than artificially inserted. Several challenges require observation, experimentation, and logical thinking without becoming excessively difficult. Particularly memorable are the interactive storybook sequences that transform illustrated pages into playable puzzles, reinforcing the game's central theme that imagination itself is a powerful force.

The gameplay is supported by an intuitive interface that keeps exploration enjoyable without unnecessary frustration. Inventory management remains simple, hints are available for players who become stuck, and adjustable difficulty options allow the experience to accommodate different skill levels. These accessibility features make the adventure welcoming to casual players while still allowing experienced puzzle enthusiasts to complete the game with minimal assistance. Progression flows naturally from one location to another, avoiding excessive backtracking while continually introducing fresh mechanics and visual themes.

Audio presentation complements the game's artistic strengths exceptionally well. The orchestral soundtrack creates a relaxing yet magical atmosphere that enhances both quiet exploration and dramatic story moments. Ambient sound effects bring each environment to life, while voice performances help establish emotional connections with the characters. Together, the music and sound design reinforce the fantasy setting and create an immersive experience that remains memorable long after the adventure concludes.

Although the game offers a polished and rewarding journey, it does have a few limitations. Its relatively short length means the adventure can be completed over several sessions, leaving players wishing for additional chapters. Some veteran adventure gamers may also find certain puzzles less demanding than expected, while the linear structure offers limited replay value beyond collectibles and bonus content. Additionally, the title retains some technical characteristics of its original release period, making parts of the interface and presentation feel slightly dated by modern standards. Fortunately, these issues rarely overshadow the overall quality of the experience.

Drawn: Trail of Shadows Collector's Edition succeeds because it consistently delivers an imaginative blend of storytelling, artistic creativity, and thoughtful puzzle design. Its gorgeous visuals, engaging fantasy narrative, varied gameplay mechanics, and relaxing atmosphere combine into an adventure that captures the wonder of classic fairy tales while offering satisfying interactive challenges. The Collector's Edition adds worthwhile content that enriches the overall package, making it an excellent choice for players who appreciate narrative-driven adventures built around exploration rather than action.

Drawn: Trail of Shadows Collector's Edition is a wonderfully crafted fantasy adventure that excels through its artistic direction, imaginative puzzles, and emotionally engaging storytelling. While its modest runtime and gentle difficulty prevent it from reaching absolute perfection, its charm, creativity, and polished presentation make it one of the more memorable point-and-click adventures available for fans of magical storytelling.

Rating: 7/10
